thread:
amy: POC customer hitting 403s intermittently on /v1/generate. They rotated keys overnight and now tests fail. Can ops/sales help triage?

jon: Can we get the exact request and response? 403 payload helps.

amy: They pasted this curl and response: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-xyz' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Org: redwood-acme' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rl2","input":"hi"}'
```
Response: `{"error":"forbidden","message":"org mismatch: token_org=redwood-beta, header_org=redwood-acme"}`

rahul: Classic key->org mixup. Their CI rotated in a staging key for a different org. Two paths: remove X-Redwood-Org so token's org wins, or get a token for the target org.

nina: Also saw repeated retries in the logs from their test runner at 2026-04-02T09:12Z; they hammered endpoint and then got some 429s. deploy-bot: quota alert for redwood-acme - 100RPM exceeded.

deploy-bot: alert: 429 rate_limit_exceeded for redwood-acme (burst). retry-after: 15s

jon: Recommend: 1) Pause test runner; 2) run whoami to confirm token binding; 3) either remove header or swap key; 4) if they need cross-org demo, we can mint a short lived cross-org token.

amy: They asked if header should ever override token binding. Short answer: no, header is advisory for routing in some multi-tenant configs but cannot escalate privileges. Will draft wording for their security team.

rahul: Also check scopes. If token only has `generate:read` (hypo), POST generate will 403. Ask them to paste whoami output. Example output we give them: 
```
{"org":"redwood-beta","project":"demo-1","scopes":["generate","embeddings"]}
```

nina: I added a quick checklist in the ticket: whoami, raw response body, whether they set X-Redwood-Org/Project, and whether they rotated CI keys.

amy: Customer wants to avoid future friction. They asked about audit logs and proof key binding. I gave them a snippet of sample log lines showing token->org mapping and rotation timestamps.

jon: For POC credits — we can issue a scoped token with limited quota (e.g., 150k tokens) and a bounded rate (say 150 RPM) for the demo period. Sales ops to confirm billing.

deploy-bot: note: incident-resolved - rate spike cleared for redwood-acme

amy: Customer swapped to the correct token and re-ran tests; 403s cleared, a couple of 429s popped up then subsided. They asked for the one-pager on token scoping + a one-liner about why headers can't escalate. I'll attach and close. :white_check_mark:
